name: MouseGestures Official Plugins
description: First-party action and detection plugins for MouseGestures.

plugins.name: Corner Dwell
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Triggers when the pointer rests in a screen corner for about a second (one trigger per corner). Unlike built-in screen zones, a quick pass through the corner does nothing.

plugins.name: Finder Helpers
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Copy the path of the selected Finder items, open Terminal at the current Finder folder, create a new Finder window, or reveal the front window's folder.

plugins.name: Focus Timer
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Start a countdown timer from a gesture (default 25 minutes) and get a notification and sound when it ends. Cancel or check it with other gestures.

plugins.name: Mouse Shake
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: A trigger that fires when you shake the pointer side to side. Bind it to any action in the gesture editor (Plugin trigger).

plugins.name: Quick Launch
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Open a URL, file, folder or app with one gesture; search the selected text on the web; open a URL from the clipboard.

plugins.name: System Events
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Triggers on system events: wake from sleep, screen locked/unlocked, display connected or disconnected, power adapter plugged in or unplugged.

plugins.name: System Toggles
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: One-gesture system switches: toggle dark mode, lock screen, sleep display, start screen saver, toggle Dock auto-hide, empty Trash.

plugins.name: Text Tools
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Transform the selected text (or clipboard): UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, trim whitespace, sort lines, paste as plain text.
